post.title: 41 AIs balanced the pole. I shoved them and 0 did. 12 generations later, 38
post.caption: 41 AIs learned to balance a pole by gen 4. Then I shoved them and all 41 dropped it. Gen 7: 2 survived the shove. Gen 10: 20. Gen 17: 38. Each AI is a small neural network; the ones that balance longest get copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Each AI is a small neural network that moves the cart to keep the pole up. No one tells it how. The best balancers get copied with random mutations into the next generation, and from gen 5 every run includes a shove.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 3189, push_at 5. surv by gen: 1,3,13,41,0,0,2,7,15,20,24,24,29,28,33,31,38. 17 - 5 = 12 gens after the shove. Idea test: question/reaction/unrealistic = 3 of 4.
